column1: # 图鉴召唤物页 11-27 用户意见后的新文案(属性取决于主人的写「未知」; 糖衣融化 + 甜蜜爆炸 合成甜蜜引信)。中文<TAB>English。
%s的攻击造成（{C:BasicConsts.DEFAULT_BASIC_COEF%%}%%×攻击力(未知) = 未知）物理伤害。
column2: The %s's attacks deal ({C:BasicConsts.DEFAULT_BASIC_COEF%%}%% × Attack (Unknown) = Unknown) physical damage.

column1: 糖果炸弹每秒损失 {C:CandySystem.BOMB_DECAY_PCT%}% 最大生命值，阵亡时爆炸，造成相当于其最大生命值 {C:CandySystem.BOMB_DEATH_AOE%}% 的魔法伤害，由所有敌人平摊。
column2: The Candy Bomb loses {C:CandySystem.BOMB_DECAY_PCT%}% of its max health per second. When it dies it explodes, dealing magic damage equal to {C:CandySystem.BOMB_DEATH_AOE%}% of its max health, split evenly among all enemies.

column1: 水晶球每 {C:CrystalSystem.ORB_RAY_IV} 秒朝最近的敌人射出一道贯穿射线，共造成（{C:CrystalSystem.ORB_RAY_COEF%}%×攻击力(未知) = 未知）魔法伤害，并给命中的敌人叠加 {C:CrystalSystem.ORB_RAY_STACKS} 层水晶，与水晶龟叠的水晶共用。
column2: Every {C:CrystalSystem.ORB_RAY_IV} seconds, the Crystal Ball fires a piercing ray at the nearest enemy, dealing a total of ({C:CrystalSystem.ORB_RAY_COEF%}% × Attack (Unknown) = Unknown) magic damage and adding {C:CrystalSystem.ORB_RAY_STACKS} Crystal stacks to enemies hit, shared with the Crystal Turtle's stacks.

column1: 海盗船每 {C:PirateSystem.SHIP_SHOT_CD} 秒朝最近的敌人开一炮，不论远近，造成（{C:PirateSystem.SHIP_SHOT_COEF%}%×攻击力(未知) = 未知）物理伤害。
column2: Every {C:PirateSystem.SHIP_SHOT_CD} seconds, the Pirate Ship fires at the nearest enemy at any distance, dealing ({C:PirateSystem.SHIP_SHOT_COEF%}% × Attack (Unknown) = Unknown) physical damage.

column1: 海盗船登场时冲进战场，对落点附近的敌人造成（{C:PirateSystem.SHIP_CHARGE_COEF%}%×海盗龟攻击力(未知) = 未知）魔法伤害，将其击退并眩晕 {C:PirateSystem.SHIP_CHARGE_STUN} 秒。
column2: On spawn, the Pirate Ship crashes into the battlefield, dealing ({C:PirateSystem.SHIP_CHARGE_COEF%}% × Pirate Turtle's Attack (Unknown) = Unknown) magic damage to enemies near the landing spot, knocking them back and stunning them for {C:PirateSystem.SHIP_CHARGE_STUN} seconds.

column1: 每 {C:CyberSystem.MECH_BLAST_CD} 秒朝当前生命值最低的敌人连开两炮，共造成（{C:CyberSystem.MECH_BLAST_COEF%}%×攻击力(未知) = 未知）物理伤害。
column2: Every {C:CyberSystem.MECH_BLAST_CD} seconds, fires two shots at the enemy with the lowest current health, dealing a total of ({C:CyberSystem.MECH_BLAST_COEF%}% × Attack (Unknown) = Unknown) physical damage.
